headline: Medicare Part A spent about $6,428 per Part A enrollee in CY2025.
basis_label: CY2025 Trustees expenditures divided by CY2025 Part A enrollment
visible_caveat: This is source-basis Medicare context, not a FY2025 OMB outlay receipt or individual liability.
allowed_public_use: Can appear in a Medicare financing/context card when paired with the Part A denominator and source basis.
blocked_public_use: Do not describe as what any enrollee paid or received personally.

headline: Medicare Part B government support was about $6,654 per Part B enrollee in CY2025.
basis_label: CY2025 Trustees government contribution divided by CY2025 Part B enrollment
visible_caveat: Part B is premium plus general support. Keep premiums and government contributions separate.
allowed_public_use: Can appear in a Part B support card when paired with the Part B denominator and source basis.
blocked_public_use: Do not label Part B as payroll-funded or pay-in/pay-out.

headline: Medicare Part D government support was about $2,623 per Part D enrollee in CY2025.
basis_label: CY2025 Trustees government contribution divided by CY2025 Part D enrollment
visible_caveat: Part D support includes premiums, government contributions, and state payments; keep those streams visible.
allowed_public_use: Can appear in a Part D support card when paired with the Part D denominator and source basis.
blocked_public_use: Do not label Part D as payroll-funded or collapse state payments into premiums.

headline: Defense-Military FY2025 outlays equal about $2,541 per CY2025 resident as a civic-cost illustration.
basis_label: FY2025 OMB Defense-Military subfunction outlays divided by Census July 1, 2025 resident population
visible_caveat: Cross-basis illustration only. It is not equal tax liability, personal benefit, or legal dedication of income-tax dollars.
allowed_public_use: Can appear as broad civic burden context with the fiscal-year/calendar-year basis visible.
blocked_public_use: Do not call it a personalized receipt or what each resident paid.

headline: Gross Treasury interest FY2025 outlays equal about $3,557 per CY2025 resident as a civic financing-cost illustration.
basis_label: FY2025 OMB gross Treasury interest subfunction outlays divided by Census July 1, 2025 resident population
visible_caveat: Cross-basis illustration only. It is not equal tax liability, personal benefit, or legal dedication of income-tax dollars.
allowed_public_use: Can appear as broad civic debt-service context with the fiscal-year/calendar-year basis visible.
blocked_public_use: Do not call it a current program benefit or legal allocation of a resident's taxes.

headline: Blocked: Medicare HI payroll financing per HI covered worker needs a Medicare-HI-specific covered-worker denominator.
basis_label: CY2025 HI payroll tax income has a source, but the denominator is not extracted.
visible_caveat: Do not substitute OASDI covered workers for Medicare HI covered workers.
allowed_public_use: Can appear only as a blocked-work item.
blocked_public_use: Do not publish a computed per-worker Medicare HI payroll figure yet.
